english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something that cannot be done without or left out.
Use this when the thing is indispensable or cannot be done without, especially when “vital” means necessary for staying alive.

examples.english: A phone is truly indispensable for work.
examples.traditional: 返工有部電話真係唔少得。
examples.jyutping: faan1 gung1 jau5 bou6 din6 waa2 zan1 hai6 m4 siu2 dak1

examples.english: People cannot go without water; it is vital for life.
examples.traditional: 人唔可以唔飲水，水係唔少得嘅。
examples.jyutping: jan4 m4 ho2 ji5 m4 jam2 seoi2 seoi2 hai6 m4 siu2 dak1 ge3
